title: Panel edit mode: Undo / redo buttons or hotkeys for last changes
line: Edit mode now has Undo and Redo buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z for adding, removing and moving widgets and adding or removing panels.
explanation: Nothing in edit mode could be undone except a removal, through the notification that pops up afterwards; an accidental add, removal or drag had to be put back by hand. Removing an applet without deleting it was also only possible through that notification's code path, so nothing else could hide and restore applets. libplasma now exposes that as Applet::setDestroyed(bool) (the notification uses the same code). The shell keeps an undo history for each edit mode session: added and removed widgets and panels are hidden or brought back as they were, and widget moves are undone by putting back the saved panel order or desktop geometries; hidden ones are deleted for good when edit mode ends. The desktop edit toolbar gets Undo and Redo buttons, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z work there and in the panel settings.

commits.message:
Applet: add setDestroyed() to remove and bring back applets quietly

The only way to remove an applet without deleting it was its remove
action, which also shows a notification to undo it. This makes that
available as API, so the shell can undo and redo edit mode changes.

BUG: 482150

shell: undo and redo changes made in edit mode

Widgets and panels added or removed in edit mode, and widgets moved
there, could only be put back by hand. The shell now records these
changes, so Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo them one by one.

BUG: 482150

desktoppackage: add Undo and Redo to the edit mode toolbar

The shell can now undo and redo the changes made in edit mode. This adds
buttons for it next to Exit Edit Mode, with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z, and
lets the desktop place its widgets again when a move is undone.

BUG: 482150

Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: add Undo and Redo to the edit mode toolbar

The shell can now undo and redo the changes made in edit mode. This adds
buttons for it next to Exit Edit Mode, with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z, and
lets the desktop place its widgets again when a move is undone.

BUG: 482150

         folderViewLayer.view.linkHere(desktopUrl);
     }
 
+    // Called by the shell when undoing or redoing widget moves made in edit mode
+    function reloadLayout(): void {
+        appletsLayout?.reloadLayout();
+    }
+
     function isDrag(fromX, fromY, toX, toY) {
         const length = Math.abs(fromX - toX) + Math.abs(fromY - toY);

media.caption: Master: two widgets added in edit mode, then Ctrl+Z: nothing happens and there is no Undo button.
Fix: Undo and Redo buttons next to Exit Edit Mode; Ctrl+Z removes the last added widget, Redo is then available.
Master: Task Manager removed from the panel, then Ctrl+Z in the panel settings: it stays removed.
Fix: same steps, Ctrl+Z puts the Task Manager back in its place and closes the notification.
Master: a desktop widget dragged elsewhere, then Ctrl+Z: it stays there.
Fix: same drag, one Ctrl+Z moves it back where it was.
